_notes.ops: Mission IDs this role has domain affinity toward, or mechanically controls. Affinity = elevated weighting in cascade menus. Watch Master is planet-level — committing a planet makes ALL missions on it eligible; missions listed are Theatre-posture affinities.
_notes.strats: Stratagem names this role contributes to the locked pool. Derived directly from stratagems.json pool fields. Excluded stratagems are not listed.
_notes.terminus: Terminus targets this role can flag (Huntmaster) or call an engagement on (Champions + domain Specialists). Roaming = Neurothrope / Carnifex / Helbrute. Fixed = mission-locked bosses.
_notes.cascade_position: Order in the downward cascade. Lower = earlier. Same number = parallel (all submit within same tier window).
_notes.vacant: Vacant role = that role's strat contributions are absent from the pool, their ops affinity is not applied, and their terminus call cannot be made.
_notes.influence_sources: command = CO chain above this role that shapes their cascade menu. track = specialist discipline lead above them in the same track (e.g. Forgemaster → Watch_Techmarine). Home chapter is a third modifier applied on top — tilts option weights, does not change option count.
_notes.floating: Dreadnoughts are unattached — not slotted into any company or KT. Their cascade contributions (strats, terminus preference) enter the pool for their tier but do not gate cascade advance if they are silent.
_notes.cascade_decision: The binding pick each role makes during their cascade window — 2-3 options generated from influence_sources outputs + home chapter weighting. Oathsworn vote on doctrine is advisory; their personal_focus pick is binding for their own prestige.

prestige_rules.prestige_mission: Running a mission that falls within the Sgt's locked doctrine on the committed planet.
prestige_rules.prestige_terminus: Killing a terminus target that Huntmaster flagged AND a Champion (any tier) or domain Specialist called the engagement on.
prestige_rules.strat_mode_bonus: Prestige mission in Hard-Strat or Omega-Strat earns more prestige than the same mission in Absolute or Omega.
prestige_rules.omega_prestige: Omega and Omega-Strat only generate prestige terminus kills when Huntmaster has flagged a terminus target for the beat.
prestige_rules.baseline: All ops by all enlisted brothers contribute baseline prestige to their KT and Company regardless of mode or mission.
prestige_rules.roaming_terminus_note: Roaming terminus spawns regardless of cascade calls. Unplanned roaming kill = regular AAR terminus kill, NOT prestige, unless Huntmaster flagged + Champion/Specialist called it.
